text:
maya_cs: Quick 20m sync at 9:30 to kick off Meridian Health onboarding — owners, must-have success criteria, timeline, and renewal watch. Can we do 9:30?
rishi_pm: Im in. I'll own product acceptance + sign-off.
emma_enable: I'll run enablement + demo. Must-haves: e2e request flow, embedding spot checks, Console ops visibility.
theo_se: I'll prep sample payloads and a tiny canary script. Note: customer mentioned 12mo retention and encryption. Need confirmation if pilot requires that.
lina_eng: SSO planned for GA; ETA ~8-10 business days. Pilot fallback = token auth. Logging SSO as a risk.
maya_cs: Timeline idea: smoke tests in 48h, internal pilot end of week, customer pilot next week. Renewal window ~11 months; recommend early usage baseline capture to build value.
rishi_pm: Actions: @theo_se -> s3://meridian/samples by 10am tomorrow; @lina_eng -> confirm SSO ETA in JIRA; @emma_enable -> schedule 30m enablement + feedback form. I'll draft acceptance checklist.
emma_enable: Scheduling 30m (15m demo + 15m Qs). Posting Confluence draft (WIP) and a 5-question survey after demo.
calendar-bot: Event created: "Meridian onboarding kickoff" at 09:30. Attendees: maya_cs, rishi_pm, emma_enable, theo_se, lina_eng.
theo_se: Uploaded samples + README with curl/python snippets to s3://meridian/samples.
lina_eng: Risk logged: "SSO_delay". Fallback plan: token auth for pilot. Also flagging: "DPA_needed" for 12mo retention/PHI ask.
maya_cs: Quick acceptance checklist (will formalize in Confluence):
```
- smoke_tests: pass
- p95_latency < 350ms
- embedding_spotcheck >= 0.9
- docs_shared: true
- week1_usage_reported
```
rishi_pm: Also ensure monitoring alerts & cost baseline set pre-pilot.
emma_enable: After demo I'll drop summary + survey link here. Plan daily 10m standups for first 5 business days to triage issues and capture feedback.
maya_cs: I'll send a 1-pager to the exec sponsor and kick off the standup series. Thanks team :rocket:
